source_text.body:
Get an independent review of a task from another Claude session
A user sends a Claude chat URL into a Cowork task so the agent can review and check the work done in that chat.
·
Jul 1, 2026
Done with
CW
Claude Cowork
CL
Claude
What they did
The user opens the same task in Claude chat in a browser and in Claude Desktop’s CoWork feature, then gives CoWork the URL of the browser chat. CoWork, with permission to use the browser and local tools, is told to bounce questions, outputs, and recommendations off the other Claude session and ask that agent questions before coming back to the person.
How it went
They say the two agents “ping pong” through the task so many issues get ironed out before handoff, which significantly reduces manual review. In their follow-up, they estimate it cuts about 90% of back-and-forth and say it works on almost all tasks.
Worth knowing
The poster says there is no fancy setup required beyond Claude Desktop’s CoWork tab and a Claude chat URL.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
Here is the URL of a Claude chat where I did some work: [chat URL]. Review the work in that chat independently: check the facts, calculations, and reasoning, and flag anything wrong, missing, or unsupported. Give me a short list of issues with suggested fixes, and don't change any files or send anything until I approve.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1ujj8au/claude_users_who_work_with_it_daily_whats_the
